name: com.innov8tif.okaycam.cam.OkayCamAutoSelfie
description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens the front camera and guides the user through a face-movement check before taking a selfie. The user can review or retake the resulting image before it is returned.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete OkayCam automatic selfie and face-check flows if this screen is disabled.
